create_constant_lr_schedule: create a constant learning rate schedule for a PyTorch optimizer using get_constant_schedule
create_cosine_schedule_with_warmup: create a cosine annealing learning rate schedule with warmup steps for a diffusion model optimizer
create_linear_schedule_with_warmup: create a linear learning rate schedule with warmup that decays to zero over training steps
create_polynomial_decay_schedule: create a polynomial decay learning rate schedule with warmup and configurable power factor
get_scheduler_by_name: get any learning rate scheduler by name string using the unified get_scheduler API
